title: 4.10 What Time Is It?
unit_outcome: Name rooms and things at home, say where things are, talk about your morning and chores, and say the day, the time and the month.
goal: Say Es ist Morgen/Nachmittag/Abend/Nacht, ask Wie spät ist es? and answer Es ist sieben Uhr morgens; p.m. uses the 24-hour clock.
grammar_function: Wie spät ist es? Es ist + number + Uhr (+ morgens/abends); 3 p.m. = fünfzehn Uhr.

cards.pedagogy_note: Clock-free day-part foundation: identify the light, sky and surroundings before combining a day period with an hour. Morning retrieves its known meaning; afternoon, evening and night are introduced.
